name: Adobe Podcast Enhance
summary: An AI-powered tool by Adobe that enhances podcast audio by removing background noise and improving sound quality.
description:
An AI-powered tool by Adobe that enhances podcast audio by removing background noise and improving sound quality.

Next generation audio from Adobe is here. Record, transcribe, edit, share. Crisp and clear, every time.

Enhance Speech: Improves audio quality to sound studio-recorded. Mic Check: Analyzes microphone setup for optimal recording. Web-Based Editing: Record, edit, and enhance audio directly in the browser. Bulk Upload: Process multiple files simultaneously.
